betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Your ME network needs to talk to the outside world, and buses are the way it happens.

§6Storage Bus §f: slaps an adjacent inventory onto the network. The network sees those items like they are on storage cells. Most common bus, most useful bus.

§6Import Bus §f: pulls items from an adjacent inventory into the network. Pair with a Crafting Upgrade and it will request items automatically when the inventory runs low.

§6Export Bus §f: pushes items from the network into an adjacent inventory. Supports Fuzzy Mode for ore-dict matching and Crafting Upgrade for on-demand crafting.

All three come in fluid variants too. Slap Speed Cards in any of them to move items faster.

§ePS:§f The Export Bus has a Scheduling Mode setting. Round-robin distributes evenly across configured slots.
